scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm build:packages && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @workspace/api build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api db:migrate
scripts.db:seed: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @workspace/api build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api db:seed
scripts.engine: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @workspace/api build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api engine
scripts.census: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @workspace/api build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api census
scripts.notify: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @workspace/api build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api notify
